# Vendored browser dependencies

These files are served locally so the Station dashboard never contacts a
third-party host:

- `tailwindcss-3.4.17.js` — Tailwind CSS browser build, MIT License,
  <https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss>
- `marked-15.0.12.min.js` — Marked, MIT License,
  <https://github.com/markedjs/marked>

When updating either file, keep the filename version pinned and verify its
upstream license and checksum before publishing.
